info.name: systems health
info.description:
Infrastructure health probe (database, cache, RabbitMQ, MinIO when configured).

Lives at **root** `/health/` — not under `/api/v1`. Uses `origin_url` (host only). Public — no auth.

request.description: Probe DB, cache, RabbitMQ, and MinIO. Returns 200 when ok, 503 when unhealthy.

variable.description: Present for collection consistency; health uses origin_url.
App origin without /api/v1 — health is mounted at /health/.
